tools.name: road_traffic_hourly_counts
tools.description: Returns the hour-by-hour manual traffic counts DfT recorded at one count point on its survey day, by direction of travel, with each direction's busiest hour and 12-hour total. tools.name: local_authority_traffic_totals
tools.description: Gives the total distance driven on all roads in one GB council area each year, in million vehicle miles (and vehicle km), for all motor vehicles and for cars and taxis, plus the area's road length, newest year first. Answers "how much traffic is there in Leeds and is it growing" for council officers

tools.description: Gives annual traffic in one GB region (English regions, Scotland or Wales) by vehicle type, in million vehicle miles: cars and taxis, vans, HGVs, buses and coaches, motorcycles and pedal cycles, plus road length, newest year first.
